summary: HTTP 404 with an empty JSON array body on /flights/* is treated as an empty result (exit 0, results:[]) instead of the template's resource-not-found error, via openSky404Empty() in helpers.go and a PATCH(opensky-flights-404-empty) block at both flights call sites.
reason: OpenSky's documented behavior: the v1 API answers 404 with an empty array when a query window has zero flights. The template's generic 404 handling prints a misleading "resource not found. Run the 'list' command" hint that confuses users on a legitimately empty window (observed on /flights/arrival for every airport tested).
validated_outcome: go build ./... and go vet ./... pass; live smoke: get-aircraft-trajectory --icao24 000001 (never-seen transponder) returns {"results":[]} with exit 0 instead of the 404 error.
